run_train_spatial_emb: run the spatial embedding training script with argparse to train context segment models over multiple epochs
train_epoch: train one epoch on a dataloader by computing loss, backpropagating, and returning average loss and error
run_visualization: run visualization on a GeoscorerDatasetVisualizer to render model predictions on example datapoints
setup_dataset_and_loader: setup the dataset and dataloader from training options for spatial embedding training
get_context_segment_trainer_modules: get context segment trainer modules including score module, loss function, and optimizer from options
